summary: Round 7 (r7b3): no GPU until 08:25 - the fleet watchdog daemon runs with a 4-box cap (config says 5) and destroyed every 5th box within a minute (harness issue in NOTES); a box got at 08:25 sat idle 2.7 h while a question to the user blocked this session. Built --energy-pot K (potential on h_E = z + |v|^2/2g, default off, tested): the greedy line loses ~600 u of energy in two impacts (the deep dip's bottom, the first basement landing) and enters the chamber only when it turns up-slope ~0.3 s earlier on the return leg. Probes: x1.0-1.3 more energy alone does not make the greedy policy enter. 11:12 r7b3_ep1 = incumbent + --energy-pot 1 (warm), evals every 6.25M.
